name: Niizawa Brewery
about: Niizawa Brewery began in 1873 as Niizawa Shoten in Sambongi, now part of Osaki, Miyagi. The earthquake of March 2011 left three brewery buildings and the family home judged a total loss, and the brewing moved to Kawasaki, 70 kilometres away, while the head office stayed in Osaki.

The brewery makes Hakurakusei, begun in 2002 as a sake to go with food and named after a local legend of a horse from Sambongi, and Atago no Matsu. It mills rice in a polisher that reaches 0.85 percent, and since 2018 its toji has been a woman who took over at 22. In 2015 it helped start Date Seven, a group of Miyagi breweries.
